items.quote: Hallelujah, a shop with integrity, transparency and urgency. As a husband and parent it is my responsibility to ensure the safety of our vehicles, my truck, my wife's SUV and the kids' cars will only be serviced and repaired at Stanley Auto Repair.

My alternator was failing, but Douglas came to the rescue and fixed it perfectly. He is a fantastic mechanic, and everyone at the shop clearly knows exactly what they are doing. Very professional service all around. Highly recommend.
Took my 05 Toyota to the shop to detect a leak with a pressure test. The leak was detected and fixed by Carlos. The price was fair and it's safe to say this will be my go-to shop in the future.

They are reliable, honest and operate with integrity. I recommend this shop for anyone who's looking for great mechanics and affordable prices. As a woman it is very difficult to find somebody you can trust with your car. They take the time to answer any questions I may have.
